Runes › Sorcery

Arcane Comet

SorceryKeystone

Damaging a champion with an ability drops a comet on them, which deals more damage the farther away you are.

What it does

Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing increased damage based on distance. Adaptive Damage: 15 - 100 based on level (+0.05 AP and +0.1 bonus AD) Cooldown: 20 - 8s Damage amplification scales up to 100% at 750 range.

When to take it

Take it on long-range mages and poke champions who hit abilities from a distance. Slow or easy-to-dodge abilities can make the comet miss.

Good on

Xerath Vel'Koz Lux Ziggs Zyra

Other Sorcery keystones

Summon Aery Stormraider's Surge Deathfire Touch
